advice.title: Take the open-circuit reference
advice.detail: Lift the probe clear of the soil and open /api/calibrate?point=air. It records what this board reads with nothing across the electrodes - a property of the board, not the soil, so it is done once. Without it a disconnected probe cannot be told from dry soil, and readings cannot be corrected for temperature. Put the probe back afterwards.

advice.title: Dry calibration looks like it was taken in air
advice.detail: The dry point is stored at 2888 mV, which is what this board reads with nothing across the electrodes. Air is an open circuit; dry soil is a resistor and reads well below it. So 0% sits where the soil can never reach, the watering thresholds may never fire, and a probe that falls out looks like a thirsty pot. Recalibrate in soil that is genuinely dry.

advice.title: Clock not set - seasonal advice suspended
advice.detail: SNTP has not synced, so the feeding, pruning and repotting rules have no date to work from and are held back. Everything measured on this page is still valid; only the calendar is missing.
